Each parts page is for one pump family, so for a different pump use its own page, such as [AD-M Gear Pump Unit Service Kits](/p/bijur-delimon-ad-m-gear-pump-unit-service-kits). Check the model on the type plate first.

faqs.q: Do you stock service parts for the motor-driven sump gear pumps, and how do I order?
faqs.a: Yes, Bijur Delimon service parts for the motor-driven sump gear pumps are held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the part numbers and quantities via [our contact page](/contact).
